platform_capability_bindings.rationale: The server-host role advertises app_host and the promoted Apps lane observes the managed app runtime.
PhotoPrism executes in the ARM64 Ubuntu/proot runtime owned by the server phone.
The protected server-host role owns the current App Host runtime.
The compute device role advertises app_host, but the promoted baseline does not prove a currently ready secondary app host.
The storage role advertises media_storage on enrolled Android/Termux nodes; no current ready storage node is promoted.
The storage device role owns media_storage capability on secondary nodes.
The storage role advertises backup_target, while readiness still depends on a current qualifying storage node.
Secondary storage nodes are the canonical remote backup-target role.
Lynis and Trivy execute behind FastAPI/worker boundaries on the Android/Termux server runtime.
The protected server-host role advertises security_scanner and promoted Security evidence observes it healthy.
The server-host and compute roles advertise compute on Android/Termux ARM64.
The protected server phone is the canonical control-plane compute host.
The compute device role advertises compute, but current readiness must still come from fresh device evidence.
